name: claude-code-orbit
description: Power-up for Claude Code: pin, archive, filter, search, and YOLO mode.

claudeCodeOrbit.devMode.description: Developer mode: reduces the update poll interval to 60s for rapid testing. Patcher installs still fetch from the authoritative remote.

claudeCodeOrbit.reaper.enabled.description: Automatically kills stale Claude Code native processes whose process tree no longer belongs to a live VS Code window.

claudeCodeOrbit.reaper.minAgeMinutes.description: Minimum age before an orphaned Claude Code native process is eligible for cleanup. Values below 5 are clamped to 5 minutes.

claudeCodeOrbit.reaper.intervalMinutes.description: How often Claude Code Orbit checks for stale Claude Code native processes.

claudeCodeOrbit.reaper.trimResumeSession.description: Opt-in: trims old, low-CPU resumed Claude Code native sessions when too many are still running. Keep disabled when long-running chats may be waiting on tools or network.
Maximum number of idle resumed Claude Code native sessions to keep running.
Minimum age before an idle resumed Claude Code native session can be trimmed. Values below 5 are clamped to 5 minutes; live resume trimming is opt-in.
Maximum sampled CPU percent for a resumed Claude Code native session to be considered idle enough to trim.
